title: The complete relevant association basis
method: associationRelevantBasisOf() derives, from the durable store only: the Attempt Invocation set, the selected Invocation event set, the source-scoped foreign creator claims, the source epoch and the store head
observed: the basis reads ONLY the Attempt own rows plus the one-session creator probe; the store head is a fast path only
expectedInvariant: the final admission basis includes every association fact the selection and Session ownership rest on
remainingUncertainty: the source-scope key is the adapter id plus the worker-bin digest, so it cannot distinguish two deployments sharing an adapter id and bin that write to different session roots (a pre-existing, documented limitation)
